saw_lines: Collectors buy the set they are missing, then judge the seller by how the last box arrived before they reorder.
So the sale is lost when a new collector finds no shipping answer or proof in the ad itself.
Your site shows 35,000+ reviews and 3,500,000+ products shipped, yet 0 of your 9 ads use either number. Put 35,000+ on the creative and open two ads with a review quote.
ads_1: Creative that answers shipping up front, uses review quotes, and lands on product pages
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Instagram, TikTok and YouTube
